reviews.title: It could be better
reviews.text:
I like this app don't get me wrong but it could be better. 
Like when you update your weight it should tell you an update on the oz of water you drink for example if you drop weight then the oz of water you should drink will be different too, you know stuff like that. But I have to enter in that information myself and I am not there greatest at math so it's unfortunate that I have to figure it out on my own because I can easily be wrong of my calculations. Just a suggestion hope to see improvement in the future. Still aside from that I like this app very much it keeps accountable for my water intake.

reviews.title: Just Downloaded!
reviews.text:
I appreciate that I can immediately track and reward my water intake as well as reward myself for doing so by earning a fish for my aquarium! I noticed in the settings I can select backgrounds, main fish, and other fish! I love this, however I have a suggestion: 

Make each fish customizable (example customizations could include naming them, creating their personality and nicknames, facts about each kind of fish and personal notes on each fish earned such as insights and notes reflecting upon making goals and achieving them, skins or selecting/coloring the fish appearances or unlocking/earning cool features like fish toys or fish treats that make your fish temporarily behave differently like they could start swimming in a unique pattern or begin flashing neon colors via skin upgrades, etc.)!

It would be even cooler if the aquarium could have options for fish interactions and still be displayed on one’s homepage or Apple Watch Face &/or device widgets.

reviews.title: Helpful Reminder

reviews.title: I like it but…
reviews.text: When I first saw this app I was excited to see another option to the plant nanny. I enjoy collecting the fish. However, the fish are not what I expected. They are pretty but they do not move like fish. They flip over like cardboard cutouts. I would love this app if by drinking water you could feed your fish. The fish need more realistic movement. It would be neat to see Gill movement as well. Make it like a real aquarium and if you do not drink the water, make the fish flop around inside a dry tank! I would definitely change my rating to five stars for this type of change!

reviews.title: Perfect

I got this to get ready for summer and just trying to be healthy and I would definitely recommend🤩💦
